plugins.name: creview
plugins.description: Multi-agent parallel code review workflow: start → triage → respond → resolve, with an automatic multi-round driver. Reviewers and fixers are resolved from the destination project's .claude/agents.

plugins.name: cprompt
plugins.description: Create and edit AI-facing prompts (agent / skill / rule / command) and self-check / fix them against prompt-discipline rules.

plugins.name: cdev
plugins.description: Team-native multi-agent coding workflow: a standing team runs design and coding as paired review cells, then a QA gate. Architects, coders, and reviewers are resolved from the destination project's .claude/agents. Requires a runtime with agent-team tools.

plugins.name: agent-sequencer
plugins.description: Claude Code skill + MCP server that lets a Python script drive an AI agent through strictly-defined workflows. Required to run creview's review_rounds.py sequencer program.
